text:
alex: Pushing v3.0.0 -> eu-west-1 (stable). Running quick post-deploy smoke checks now. ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: canary promotion applied: eu-west-1 -> 3% traffic. healthcheck: all ready, liveness ok. starting synthetic short-suite.

lee: kick off short-suite: `./infra/smoke/run --region=eu-west --suite=quick`

ops-bot: short-suite results: 8/8 samples OK, p50=39ms p95=98ms errors=0. synthetic watchdog: no regressions.

nora: I'm seeing intermittent 503s on prefiller-eu at 11:04:12 UTC, small sample: 
```
11:04:10 prefiller-eu-2 req=xyz status=200 t=34ms
11:04:12 prefiller-eu-1 req=xyy status=503 t=70ms reason=upstream_unavailable
11:04:13 prefiller-eu-3 req=xzz status=200 t=36ms
```

alex: Hm. Not great. Are these from the new variant? Any correlation with model-serving nodes?

infra-bot: correlate logs: 6/20 503s originated on nodepool model-serve-eu-2; CPU spike coincident at 11:03:58.

lee: Looks like prefill memory pressure on model-serve-eu-2. Rolling back prefill config change from v3.0.0 on that nodepool: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/prefill -n eu-west --to-revision=2 --selector=nodepool=model-serve-eu-2`

ops-bot: extended-suite queued (full-coverage). ETA ~15m.

alex: Temporary mitigation: hold global ramp. Pin non-critical embed routes in eu-west to v2.16.9 while we collect telemetry. We'll keep canary at 3% for 30m. If 503 rate <=0.2% and extended-suite clean -> proceed. If >0.6% for 5m -> rollback entirely.

nora: Agreed. I'll add a dashboard alert: `alert:prefill.503.rate > 0.6% for 5m` and notify oncall.

lee: Undo patch applied on model-serve-eu-2, pods restarting. Monitoring pod restarts now.

infra-bot: pod restart: model-serve-eu-2-7 restarted at 11:06:05, memory back to baseline.

ops-bot: extended-suite partial: 120/120 queries OK so far, tail latency p99=420ms (within target), tokenization diffs=2 (minor).

alex: Re-evaluating: leave canary pinned at 3% for another 15m. If no further 503s, resume staged ramp to 25% tomorrow change window at 08:00 UTC. Add release note: "Prefill behavior tweak; monitoring added for prefiller 503s."

deploy-bot: rollout: paused by alex. pin set: eu-west-1 -> v3.0.0 at 3% until 3001235467.

lee: Action items: 1) nora monitor alerts and logs, 2) infra to validate nodepool memory config revert, 3) ops to run regression smoke runbook in 10m.

nora: On it. Posting dashboard link: https://console.redwood/dashboards/prefill-eu.

alex: Thanks team. If extended-suite finishes green and alerts quiet, we'll schedule staged ramp with ops signoff.
